rungs.title: Sales Associate
rungs.summary: Learning the products, the pitch and the process.
rungs.knowledge: Knows the products and the pitch well enough to answer the common questions.
rungs.delivery: Works leads handed to them and logs every conversation.
rungs.leadership: Listens in on calls, asks for coaching and keeps the pipeline honest.

rungs.title: Sales Executive
rungs.summary: Runs deals from first call to close.
rungs.knowledge: Knows every product, how it is billed and what AI can do for the buyer.
rungs.delivery: Finds their own leads and runs deals from first call to close.
rungs.leadership: Builds lasting relationships with customers and the delivery team.

rungs.title: Senior Sales Executive
rungs.summary: Wins larger accounts and coaches the team.
rungs.knowledge: Understands pricing, billing, data and communication well enough to shape larger deals.
rungs.delivery: Wins larger accounts and forecasts them accurately.
rungs.leadership: Coaches newer colleagues and leads a pursuit across several teams.

rungs.title: Head of Sales
rungs.summary: Owns pipeline, pricing and the sales team.
rungs.knowledge: Reads the numbers, the market and the delivery constraints together.
rungs.delivery: Owns pipeline, pricing and the target for the whole team.
rungs.leadership: Hires, coaches and holds a team to account; speaks for sales at the top table.
